title: Beyond Aggregate Accuracy: Item-Level Transitions in Prompt Optimization
why: Prompts revised by an optimizer from item-level recovery/regression/churn feedback on solver runs; model weights fixed.

title: DoVer: Intervention-Driven Auto Debugging for LLM Multi-Agent Systems
why: Multi-agent system messages and plans repaired via intervention-verified failure hypotheses from its own failed execution traces.

title: AgenTracer: Who Is Inducing Failure in the LLM Agentic Systems?
why: Trajectory failure attribution via counterfactual replay; tracer feedback lets multi-agent systems self-correct; tracer itself RL-trained.

title: The Last Harness: agent harness that rewrites itself, kept only if real edge hardware measures gains
why: Repo: reflector rewrites team harness (instructions, playbook, tools, structure) from traces; edits kept only if device measurements improve.

title: SPARKLETEAM: Towards Recursive Self Home Improvement (hackathon project + paper PDF)
why: Repo+PDF: Nemotron agent team rewrites own prompts, playbook, tools and team structure from DishwasherBench scores, keeping improving edits.

title: Agent-Dojo agentic self-improvement: replay-proven failure causes become prompt rules
why: Repo: stronger model attributes failures, replay-verifies causes, writes prompt rules for weaker agent, kept only if train success improves.

title: EvidenceGate: statistically gated self-improvement for tool-using agents
why: Repo/testbed: agent's SKILL.md edits proposed from failures, accepted only via held-out paired statistical validation; loop still in progress.

title: supervised-self-improving-agent: self-code-editing agent behind a frozen evaluator and review panel
why: Repo: agent proposes edits to its own code, gated by frozen evaluator, cross-model review and hash-chained ledger; human merges.

title: Veloce Forge: self-improving agents that cannot promote themselves
why: Repo: agent writes its own tools from failing feedback cases; adopted only if beating current tool on held-out cases plus human approval.

title: OmniEvolve: evolutionary code and prompt optimization with lineage ledger
why: Repo: island-model LLM evolutionary search rewrites code, prompt templates or configs against benchmark scores; OpenEvolve-style.

title: Project Singularity: self-improving harness for autonomous software delivery with Claude Code
why: Repo: Claude Code plugin harness whose agents, skills and pipelines improve from recorded project experience and eval cases.

title: Khoros: self-improving agentic software factory with bounded Kaizen loop
why: Repo: multi-agent coding factory with Kaizen loop using causal credit attribution to revise agent capsules and workflows.

title: Prompt Lab: open, model-agnostic prompt optimization
why: Repo: reflective prompt optimization: scores outputs, optimizer model explains low scorers, rewrites prompt, repeats while scores improve.

title: adaptive-agent: self-improving agent with editable memory, skill library and self-critique
why: Repo: Voyager/Reflexion-style agent saving validated skills and critique lessons to memory from its own task successes and failures.
